name: Preamble / Consideration
text: This Agreement is made by and between the CITY OF YOUNGSTOWN, OHIO (hereinafter the "City") and HARDRIVES PAVING & CONSTRUCTION, INC. (hereinafter “Hardrives”), an Ohio corporation. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual representations, warranties, and covenants contained herein, the parties agree as follows:

name: 1. Grant of License
text: 1. The City agrees to grant to Hardrives a license for use of the property, including, but not limited io, fixtures, existing improvements, and appurtenant structures thereon, all located within the City and described more fully in the attached Exhibit A (hereinafter the "Premises").

name: 2. Use
text: 2. Use. The City and Hardrives agree that the Premises will be declared surplus property and deemed not needed for public use by the Director of Finance and is to be used in connection with economic development purposes. Hardrives intends to utilize the Premises for the production, distribution, and sale of paving materials and other similar products and for the operation of its management and corporate offices. The Premises will further be used for the storage and operation of all equipment, personal property, and supplies necessary for said purposes.

name: 3. Rental
text: 3. Rental. Hardrives agrees to pay to the City a rental fee of one dollar ($1.00) per year.

name: 4. Event of Default
text: 4, Event of Default. Failure to make annual payments within thirty (80) days of the date payment is due shall constitute an event of default. Upon written notice by the City, Hardrives shall have ten (10) days, within which to cure such default. If said default is not cured within that ten (10) day period: following notice from the City, Hardrives shall be held to have breached this Agreement and shall surrender all rights to the use of the Premises.

name: 5. Terms
text: 5. Terms. This Agreement shall continue: (1) for a term of one (1) year from the date of execution of this Agreement; or (2) until the date that title to the Premises is conveyed and transferred to Hardrives by the City, pursuant to a Development Agreement entered into by and between the City and Hardrives, regarding the Premises, which shall be entered into on or before December 31, 1999.

name: 6.A. City Warranty - Authorization
text: 6. Representation and Warranties of the City. The City represents and warrants to Hardrives, as follows: A. As of the date hereof, and on the date of the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement, the Board of Control for the City has been duly authorized by the City Council to enter into this Agreement, and this Agreement constitutes a valid and binding obligation of the City.

name: 6.B. City Warranty - Authority and Clear Title
text: B. The City has full authority to license the use of the Premises and said Premises shall be clear of all liens and claims of any party, except for easements of record, any and all unrecorded easements identified by the City prior to the execution of this Agreement, rights of way, and access rights appurtenant to the Center Street Bridge and access ramps thereto. Further, the City is not in default under any law or regulation or under any order of any court or federal, state, or municipal or other governmental department, commission, board, bureau, agency, or instrumentality affecting the Premises. Finally, there are no claims, actions, suits, or proceedings instituted, filed or threatened, which may affect the Premises.

name: 6.C. City Warranty - Easements and Rights of Way
text: C. This license to Hardrives by the City will include the right to use all easements and right of ways, as may be necessary to have access to, and utilization of, the Premises.

name: 6.D. City Warranty - Environmental
text: D. The Premises has never, and does not currently contain, nor is it contaminated by, any hazardous or toxic waste materials, except as set forth in the Environmental Site Assessment Phase | and If report attached hereto as Exhibit B, in violation of any applicable environmental laws or regulations, including, but not limited to, Section 103 of the Comprehensive Environmental Response, Compensation and Liability Act, 42 U.S.C. D9601 et seq. and Chapter 3734 of the Ohio Revised Code. Further, no “clean-up” of the Premises has occurred pursuant to any applicable federal or state environmental laws or regulations, which would give rise to (i) liability on the part of any person, entity, or association to reimburse any governmental authority for the costs of such “clean-up,” or (ii) a lien or encumbrance on the Premises.

name: 7.A. Hardrives Warranty - Authorization
text: f. Representation and Warranties of Hardrives. Hardrives represents and warrants to the City as follows: A. As of the date hereof, and on the date of the execution and performance of this Agreement, Hardrives has been duly authorized to enter into this Agreement, and this Agreement constitutes a valid and binding obligation of Hardrives.

name: 7.B. Hardrives Warranty - No Waste / Surrender
text: B. Hardrives agrees to lay no waste to the Premises during the term of its use of the Premises and to surrender the Premises to the City upon termination of this Agreement in as good a condition as received, normal wear and tear and damage due to casualty excepted.

name: 7.C. Hardrives Warranty - Insurance
text: C. During the term of this Agreement, Hardrives shall maintain a policy of insurance in the amount of $1,000,000.00 to include comprehensive liability coverage naming the City, as an additional insured of said policy. Hardrives shall maintain worker's compensation insurance on its employees and shall provide the City with a certificate thereof.

name: 7.D. Hardrives Warranty - Hazardous Materials
text: D. Hardrives shall use all precautions necessary to ensure against the creation, use, or storage of any hazardous material or waste on the Premises. Hardrives agrees that, during its use of the Premises, Hardrives will comply with Environmental Protection Agency laws or regulations in effect presently or enacted during the term of this Agreement.

name: 7.E. Hardrives Warranty - Indemnification
text: E. Hardrives agrees to hold harmless the City against any and all claims, liabilities, damages, and losses, including expenses incidental to the defense of same, resulting from injury on or about the Premises or in conjunction with Hardrives’ use and occupancy of the Premises.

name: 7.F. Hardrives Warranty - Compliance of Work
text: F. All work performed on the Premises shall be in conformity with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

name: 8. As Is Condition
text: 8. Hardrives acknowledges that it is accepting the Premises in its "as is" condition, without any express or implied warranty of the condition of the Premises, apart from warranties and representations made by the City, which are contained in this Agreement.

name: 9. Entire Agreement / Amendment / Assignment
text: 9. This Agreement, and the documents delivered pursuant hereto, constitute the entire Agreement and understanding between the parties hereto. This Agreement may be modified or amended only by a duly authorized written instrument executed by the parties hereto. . This Agreement is not assignable by either party without the written consent of the other party.

name: 10. Governing Law
text: 10. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Ohio.

name: 11. Survival
text: 11. All warranties, covenants, representations, and guarantees shall survive the execution and delivery of this Agreement and any other documents contemplated by the Agreement.

name: 12. Successors and Assigns
text: 12. The terms "City" and “Hardrives," as both are used herein, shall include all persons so designated and their heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns.
